question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "trained."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "trained"** means having been trained by a specified person or organization. (किसी निर्दिष्ट व्यक्ति या संगठन द्वारा प्रशिक्षित किया गया हो)

 
 
• ​Example: *She is a **trained**__ singer.*
 
 
 
• The paragraph conveys that he could see why these really skilled specialists stayed hidden.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is ‘Option 4.'
 
• Correct sentence: 

I understood why these highly __**trained**__ professionals remained in the closet. I was one of ______ (2) ______. We could not deny our ______ (3) ______ experiences and senses. Yet our training was in many ways diametrically ______ (4) ______ to the information, experiences and beliefs we had accumulated. So we remained ______ (5) ______. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Thought: **an idea or opinion. (कोई विचार या मत)
 
• **Train: **to teach a person to do something which is difficult or which needs practice. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को कठिन या अभ्‍यास की अपेक्षा वाला काम सिखाना, प्रशिक्षण देना)
 
• **Studied: **carefully planned or done, especially when you are trying to give a particular impression. (सुविचारित या सम्‍यक रीति से किया गया (विशेषतः एक विशेष प्रकार का प्रभाव डालने की दृष्टि से))
